dossiers.loading.note: Loading message while the list of people and places loads (as in mustering troops); the interface adds an ellipsis

dossiers.loading_sheet.note: Loading message while one person's or place's profile loads; the interface adds an ellipsis

dossiers.kicker.note: Small heading above the page title: the people and places of the story

dossiers.title.note: Page title: profiles of the people, places and other entities in the text

dossiers.all.note: Filter chip that shows entities of every type; a count follows it

dossiers.type.person.note: Entity type, as a filter chip in lower case; also the profile's type line, shown in capitals

dossiers.type.deity.note: Entity type, as a filter chip in lower case; also the profile's type line, shown in capitals

dossiers.type.spirit_being.note: Entity type (angels and other spirits), as a filter chip in lower case; also the profile's type line, shown in capitals

dossiers.type.location.note: Entity type (a place), as a filter chip in lower case; also the profile's type line, shown in capitals

dossiers.type.group.note: Entity type (a people, a band, a household), as a filter chip in lower case; also the profile's type line, shown in capitals

dossiers.type.artifact.note: Entity type (a made object), as a filter chip in lower case; also the profile's type line, shown in capitals

dossiers.type.substance.note: Entity type (flour, oil, water…), shown in capitals as the profile's type line

dossiers.count.events.note: Number of events an entity takes part in, abbreviated to fit a list row ('ev' = events)

dossiers.count.interactions.note: Number of interactions between this entity and others, abbreviated to fit a list row ('int' = interactions)

dossiers.count.states.note: Number of states an entity goes through (alive, widowed, king…), abbreviated to fit a list row ('st' = states)

dossiers.no_tipnr.note: Shown when the entity has no identifier in TIPNR (Translators Individualised Proper Names, a reference dataset); keep the name TIPNR

dossiers.first_at.note: Where the entity is first mentioned; {verse} is a verse reference link such as 1KGS.17.1

dossiers.name_means.note: Label before the meaning of the person's or place's name, e.g. 'Name means: my God is the LORD'

dossiers.stats.note: Panel title: counts about the entity, shown as bars

dossiers.stat.events.note: Bar label in the Stats panel; the column is narrow

dossiers.stat.interactions.note: Bar label in the Stats panel; the column is narrow

dossiers.stat.states.note: Bar label in the Stats panel (conditions such as alive, widowed, king); the column is narrow

dossiers.stat.mentions.note: Bar label in the Stats panel: how many words in the text name the entity; the column is narrow

dossiers.on_the_map.note: Button that opens the place on the Atlas map

dossiers.appearances.note: Panel title: a chart of where in the text the entity is mentioned, verse by verse

dossiers.no_mentions.text: No word-level mentions (not a TIPNR individual).
dossiers.no_mentions.note: TIPNR is a reference dataset of proper names; keep the name

dossiers.state_timeline.note: Panel title: when the entity's states (alive, widowed, king…) begin and end, along the verses

dossiers.events.note: Panel title: the events this entity takes part in

dossiers.interactions.note: Panel title: what this entity does to or with others

dossiers.like.note: Panel title: entities most similar in meaning to {name}

dossiers.same_type.note: Toggle chip: compare only with entities of the same type

dossiers.any_entity.note: Toggle chip: compare with entities of every type

dossiers.kindred_empty: Nothing else of this type yet.
